package.description: A lightweight native launcher for Goopie and ReXGlue-based recompilation projects.

en-US.description: A lightweight native launcher for Goopie and ReXGlue-based recompilation projects.
en-US.longDescription: Goopie Launcher loads the Goopie web UI (goopie.xyz) and bridges native functionality through a local loopback HTTP server. It browses and launches installed ReXGlue-based recompilation projects, offers an offline mode with an embedded copy of the Goopie website, and integrates features such as Discord Rich Presence and Steam shortcut management.
en-US.name: Goopie Launcher

zh-CN.description: 轻量级的 Goopie 原生桌面启动器。
zh-CN.longDescription: Goopie Launcher 加载 Goopie 网页界面（goopie.xyz），并通过本地回环 HTTP 服务器桥接原生功能。它可以浏览并启动已安装的 ReXGlue 重编译项目，提供内置 Goopie 网站离线副本的离线模式，并集成了 Discord Rich Presence 与 Steam 快捷方式管理等功能。
